metadata.title: Dewangga Praxindo | Web3 Security Researcher
metadata.description: Web3 security researcher (3+ yrs). Audit contests on Sherlock and Code4rena, audited Solidity and Sui Move protocols ($50M+ TVL, 3 audits, 0 criticals), plus AI agents and Next.js products.

hero.srHeadline: Dewangga Praxindo. Web3 security researcher securing the smart contracts that move real money, and building the AI systems and products around them.
hero.headline: Securing the contracts that move money.
hero.lede: I'm a Web3 security researcher based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. I audit the contracts that hold real money, and I build the AI systems and products around them. $50M+ TVL deployed, three PeckShield audits, zero criticals.

capabilities.title: Six things I can secure and ship for you, end-to-end.

securityResearch.title: Security Research
securityResearch.desc: Audit contests on Sherlock and Code4rena. Threat models before a line of code, Slither and Aderyn on every PR. Three PeckShield audits on protocols I engineered, zero critical findings.

smartContracts.title: Smart Contracts
smartContracts.desc: Solidity and Rust. Heavy testing before any audit: fuzz tests, invariants, and mutation testing run on every change.

defiOnchain.title: DeFi & Onchain
defiOnchain.desc: Vaults, liquidity pools, and yield strategies that hold real user money. Production protocols on Arbitrum and Ethereum.

aiEngineering.title: AI Engineering
aiEngineering.desc: LLM agents, RAG pipelines, and evals that actually ship. Function calling, tool use, retrieval, and guardrails, from prompt to production.

fullstackApps.title: Full-Stack Apps
fullstackApps.desc: React, Next.js, TypeScript end to end. Auth, payments, realtime, and the database underneath. I ship the whole product, not a slice.

infraShip.title: Infra & Ship
infraShip.desc: CI/CD, observability, and cloud. Postgres, edge functions, queues. The unglamorous parts that keep products alive at 3am.

bullets.0: Understand the problem before the stack. Read the code, the specs, the prior art.
bullets.1: Map the data flow and the trust boundaries. Mark every place value or state crosses one.
bullets.2: Pick the tools that fit (model, framework, chain) and write the spec we build to.

bullets.0: Ship in vertical slices. Working software every week, not a big-bang reveal.
bullets.1: Tests live next to the code: evals for AI, e2e for apps, fuzz & invariants for contracts.
bullets.2: CI on every push. Type-safe end to end. Coverage gate before anything merges.

bullets.0: Deploy with rollback. Feature flags, timelocks, and a tested kill switch on the money paths.
bullets.1: Monitoring, logging, and traces wired in. I get paged before users do.
bullets.2: Audit the critical paths. On-call for the first 30 days after every launch.

works.title:
Seven projects.
All live or in production.

taglines.toldproof: A way for AI agents and people to prove their predictions are honest. Sealed on Sui, revealed on time.
taglines.amaly: A full-stack prayer-tracking app for Ramadan. Quran reader, streaks, and a leaderboard. Shipped as a PWA.
taglines.factor: DeFi yield strategies on Arbitrum. I am a core engineer: leverage vaults, LP management, the contracts that hold $50M+ TVL.
taglines.rekon: AI-powered esports predictions on Polymarket. Model picks the edge, you pay in USDC with one click.
taglines.lazor: A Solana wallet template with Face ID and Touch ID. No seed phrases.
taglines.vouch: Prove things about your Solana wallet without revealing who you are. Built with Noir zero-knowledge circuits.
taglines.boh: NFT battle game with fair, verifiable randomness. Chainlink hackathon winner in 2022.

audits.title:
Audited code.
Zero critical findings, so far.
audits.credDesc: Graduated from RektOff's Solana security bootcamp. Auditing Anchor and native programs: account validation, CPI safety, and the exploit patterns that drain protocols.
audits.contestDesc: Public audit contests on Sherlock and Code4rena, competing against the whole field to find bugs before attackers do. Two Medium-severity findings on the XRP Ledger contest, finishing 20th.

contact.lede: I reply in under 24 hours on weekdays. Available for security reviews, audit contests, AI engineering, and full-stack product builds, starting Q2 2026.
